registry_name: Platform B1 / Thread D2 No-Bind Governance Doctrine Registry
doctrine_name: No-Bind Governance™ / Silence Is Not Consent Doctrine
doctrine_principle: Absence of human response must not be treated as authorization.
master_sentence: No-Bind Governance™ means an AI-mediated action cannot bind an organization to consequence merely because no human responded. Silence must create a governed hold, escalation, and documented pause — not implied permission.
purpose: Define a local Platform B1 / Thread D2 doctrine registry for authority absence, silence handling, governed hold states, escalation, and action non-admissibility in AI-mediated regulated workflows.
workstreams: Thread D2 — RAMAT Vision Advanced Assurance Preview

platform_relationship.platform_a_role: Capture governance intent, authority model, consequential action scope, escalation design, silence-default rule, and evidence requirements.
platform_relationship.platform_b1_role: Evaluate whether evidence, authority, timing, accountability, and admissibility are sufficient for action in the preview workstream.
platform_relationship.thread_d2_role: Display authority, hold, escalation, and non-admissibility state only through RAMAT Vision preview surfaces.
platform_relationship.ramat_vision_role: Display only; does not approve, release, override, or bind regulated action.
platform_relationship.human_role: Named authorized person, authorized role, or governed pre-authorized rule remains accountable for consequential action.

decision_rule: If required authority is absent, invalid, unavailable, stale, unsupported by evidence, outside timing, or not accountable to a named person, role, or governed rule, the AI-mediated action is not admissible and must enter a governed hold or escalation state.
